methods.name: createClient
methods.description: Creates a specific AWS service client by name using provided configuration options. It retrieves service metadata via the manifest() function, constructs the client class name, and initializes it with merged arguments.

methods.name: createMultiRegionClient
methods.description: Creates a multi-region version of an AWS service client, defaulting to a generic MultiRegionClient class if a specific class does not exist.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Clones the current SDK instance with additional or overridden configuration arguments.

methods.name: mergeArgs
methods.description: Merges default arguments from the SDK, service-specific arguments, and any provided overrides, ensuring proper configuration for client instantiation.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Handles dynamic method calls for client creation, routing to createClient or createMultiRegionClient based on method name prefix.

methods.name: getEndpointPrefix
methods.description: Deprecated static method to retrieve the endpoint prefix for a given service namespace, now replaced by the manifest() function.
